glossary.definition: A vector database stores those numerical embeddings and can quickly find the ones most similar to a given query, out of millions or billions of entries. It's like a librarian who, instead of matching your exact search words, understands the gist of what you're after and pulls the books that are actually about that topic. It's the piece of infrastructure that lets an AI product search "by meaning" instead of by exact keyword match.

items.title: Three insights you may have missed from theCUBE’s coverage of the Dell Technologies New York Symposium
items.summary: AI operational readiness requires more than selecting the right servers, storage and computing capacity. Those considerations are particularly consequential for financial institutions, where reliability, regulatory obligations and the need to demonstrate returns on technology investments shape deployment decisions. Meanwhile, AI is changing the threat landscape, giving less sophisticated attackers access to capabilities that once required considerably greater resources, according to John Scimone , president and chief security officer of Dell Technologies Inc. “I think the pyramid still exists, but undoubtedly, the cost of entry and the barriers to entry have crumbled,” he told theCUBE .

items.title: Cops Are Pushing Extremely Corny ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’ Slop
items.summary: The blockbuster game makes no secret of its contempt for law enforcement. Real police departments using it to recruit new members and scold the public apparently didn’t get the memo. Listening to the in-game radio stations while you cruise around in Grand Theft Auto VI , you might hear a recruitment ad for the Vice City Police Department, which makes no secret of the kind of maladjusted psychos it's looking for. ” one spot begins.

items.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
items.summary: Researchers planted 2 million digital tripwires in requests sent through a sprawling network of AI services to find out what happened to sensitive information entrusted to them. What they discovered was an ecosystem that leaked highly sensitive data like a sieve. The exposure was found through an ingenious experiment designed to test if sensitive information can leak through the vast chain of widely used AI services and how that information is exploited when it does. Many of today’s AI apps use services such as OpenRouter or Vercel that act as brokers.

items.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
items.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns. items.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
items.summary: Mathematicians are having their minds blown by the latest AI-driven result — and there's a competing human solution, too. It’s a big week for Levent Alpöge: The mathematician saw his employer, Anthropic, become the first publicly traded frontier AI lab. He also appears to have solved one of the most important problems in mathematics. “The precise timing is horrible,” he wrote in an essay announcing his findings and describing how he messaged Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei last Sunday night to ask how to announce that he had found a Lean-compilable solution to the Riemann hypothesis, which dates back to 1859 and is among the Millennium Prize math problems.

items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.summary: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a press conference Friday following his summit with China President Xi Jinping and Russia President Vladimir Putin. "They allowed that to happen with chips and everything else, and it was very destructive to our country. While policymakers across the country are putting new restrictions on the data center buildout, Trump is making threats.

items.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
items.summary: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding. The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely shared— and widely misinterpreted , owing to the complexity of the measures it used. METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans. Each task’s difficulty was scored by how long it took the human testers to finish it—and then models were rated according to the length of the tasks that they could complete.

items.title: Goa Wants to Train 50,000 Graduates in AI Skills
items.summary: The Goa Cabinet approved the Goa Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy 2026, a three-year roadmap covering AI adoption across education, industry, startups, and governance. The policy allocates 60% of its resources to AI skilling and capacity building, while startup promotion and support and infrastructure development will receive 20% each. The skilling component will extend AI training across different educational levels. It will include training, certification, and capacity-building programmes.

items.title: Forget Organic Growth, AI is Forcing Mid-Cap Indian IT to Reinvent M&A Playbook
items.summary: During Coforge’s Q2 earnings call, an analyst asked Chief Financial Officer Saurabh Goel to explain the gap between consolidated and organic growth. Revenue grew 10.9% sequentially in constant currency, against organic growth of 3.8%, indicating how much acquisitions are supplementing the company's growth. Goel attributed the difference partly to the consolidation of a full quarter of Encora's revenue in Q2, compared to only two months in Q1. Encora, the digital engineering firm Coforge acquired for ₹22,090 crore, contributed ₹1,382–1,391 crore in revenue.

items.title: 21 ways Gemini can genuinely be useful on Android
items.summary: Google’s Gemini chatbot gets a bit of a bad rap as an Android assistant — and, let’s be honest: It’s easy to see why. Google rushed Gemini out of the gates long before it was ready . It crippled the perfectly fine Google Assistant experience , and even with all the progress over time, Gemini still can’t do everything Assistant did in terms of day-to-day device basics — despite having now fully replaced Assistant and sent that service to the Google Graveyard . Beyond that, Gemini can be complicated and confusing , with its many models and cryptically coded options.

items.title: Agentic AI repeats same old enterprise adoption cycle
items.summary: The pitch sounded perfect. A large regional distributor needed to build a new sales transaction management system. The goal was straightforward: automate parts of order intake, discount approvals, exception handling, customer communications, and inventory checks. It was not a trivial system, but it was also something the industry had built before. Then the vendor presentations began.
